papers.title_en: EmoTaG: Emotion-Aware Talking Head Synthesis on Gaussian Splatting with Few-Shot Personalization
papers.authors: Haolan Xu, Keli Cheng, Lei Wang, Ning Bi, Xiaoming Liu
papers.evidence: 多模态合成中的情感感知运动建模
papers.tldr: 针对现有少样本3D说话人脸合成中存在的几何不稳定和情感不匹配问题，本文提出EmoTaG框架。该方法基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS），通过在结构化的FLAME参数空间中重构运动预测，并引入门控残差运动网络（GRMN）来捕捉音频中的情感韵律和头部姿态，实现了高保真、情感丰富且运动稳定的少样本个性化合成。
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven 3D talking head synthesis has advanced rapidly with Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). By leveraging rich pre-trained priors, few-shot methods enable instant personalization from just a few seconds of video. However, under expressive facial motion, existing few-shot approaches often suffer from geometric instability and audio-emotion mismatch, highlighting the need for more effective emotion-aware motion modeling. In this work, we present EmoTaG, a few-shot emotion-aware 3D talking head synthesis framework built on the Pretrain-and-Adapt paradigm. Our key insight is to reformulate motion prediction in a structured FLAME parameter space rather than directly deforming 3D Gaussians, thereby introducing explicit geometric priors that improve motion stability. Building upon this, we propose a Gated Residual Motion Network (GRMN), which captures emotional prosody from audio while supplementing head pose and upper-face cues absent from audio, enabling expressive and coherent motion generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EmoTaG achieves state-of-the-art performance in emotional expressiveness, lip synchronization, visual realism, and motion stability.
